प्रलय m. 1. Destruction, annihilation; 2. any extensive destruction; 3. the destruction of the whole world at the end of a kalpa, K.S.ii.6, Bg.vii.6; 4. death, यदा सवे प्रवृद्धे तु प्रलयं याति देहभृत् Bg.xiv.14; 5. loss of consciousness considered as one of the 33 subordinate feelings (in rhetoric); 8. the mystic syllable om.
